title: Contractor Client Update Automation: Weekly Progress Without Endless Text Threads
author: WNY Business Automation
metaDescription: Build a contractor client update automation workflow for Buffalo and WNY remodelers, with weekly progress, decisions, delay alerts, and human review.
excerpt: A practical workflow for remodelers and long-duration project contractors to assemble reviewed weekly updates from schedule status, photos, decisions, delays, and next steps.
